title: Green Synthesis of Selenium Nanoparticles Using Rosemary Aqueous Extract and Ascorbic Acid
author: Mohammadreza Ashayeri
materials: DLS: Expected size: 45–90 nm depending on formulation.
Formation of stable SeNPs with red/orange coloration.
Rosemary extract improves capping efficiency and nanoparticle uniformity.

steps.title: Grind dried rosemary leaves
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g dried rosemary leaves and grind them to a fine powder.

steps.title: Extract rosemary in water
steps.instruction: Add the powdered rosemary to 100 mL fresh deionized water in a beaker, heat the mixture to 40 °C and stir at 1800 rpm for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Clarify and store extract
steps.instruction: Transfer the hot extract to a centrifuge tube, centrifuge at 6000 rpm for 30 minutes, collect the supernatant, filter it through a Whatman No. 1 filter paper **or** a 0.45 µm membrane, and store the clarified rosemary extract at 4 °C (use within 24–48 hours).

steps.title: Prepare sodium selenite solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.263 g Na₂SeO₃ in 100 mL deionized water.

steps.title: Prepare ascorbic acid solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.176 g ascorbic acid in 100 mL deionized water; prepare fresh because it is sensitive to oxidation.

steps.title: Heat sodium selenite aliquot
steps.instruction: Take 20 mL of the sodium selenite solution and heat it to 60 °C.

steps.title: Add rosemary extract
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of the prepared rosemary extract dropwise to the heated sodium selenite over 2–4 minutes while stirring, then continue stirring so that the total stirring time after addition reaches 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add ascorbic acid
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL of a 10 mM ascorbic acid solution dropwise over 3–5 minutes while stirring, then continue stirring so that the total stirring time after addition reaches 30 minutes.

steps.title: Incubate reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at 37 °C for 48 hours.

steps.title: Pellet nanoparticles
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the incubated mixture at 8000 rpm for 20 minutes. If no pellet forms, add 50 mM NaCl to reduce colloidal stability; rosemary‑capped nanoparticles may require centrifugation at 10 000–12 000 rpm.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in deionized water, and repeat the centrifugation‑wash cycle 2–3 times.

steps.title: Store final nanoparticle dispersion
steps.instruction: Store the final selenium nanoparticle dispersion at 4 °C; it remains stable for up to 4 weeks.

steps.title: Safety precautions
steps.instruction: Handle sodium selenite in a fume hood, wearing gloves, mask, and goggles; dispose of selenium waste as hazardous heavy metal. Avoid inhalation of rosemary powder during grinding.
